text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening position and repeated claims for driverless cars","quality":"argumentative stance","description":"The essay states a position early and keeps defending it throughout the response."},{"evidence":"uses fuel savings, taxi system, safety alerts, and texting/driving","quality":"supporting evidence","description":"The essay draws on multiple details from the article to back up its claims rather than relying on a single example."},{"evidence":"addresses objections about accidents and liability","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges opposing concerns and responds to them instead of ignoring the other side."},{"evidence":"intro, body paragraphs, and concluding wrap-up","quality":"organizational structure","description":"The essay is organized into a recognizable introduction, body, and conclusion that make the argument easy to follow."},{"evidence":"smooth section starters like 'First,' 'Next,' 'Also,' and 'So,'","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay uses transitions to connect ideas and signal the movement from one point to the next."}]}
